{"code": "import numpy as np

# Check baseline balance between sexes for key covariates
# Compute mean age and baseline biomarker by sex
baseline_balance = df.groupby('sex')[['age', 'biomarker_baseline']].mean()

age_diff = baseline_balance.loc['F', 'age'] - baseline_balance.loc['M', 'age']
biomarker_diff = baseline_balance.loc['F', 'biomarker_baseline'] - baseline_balance.loc['M', 'biomarker_baseline']

# Print the results
print(f"Mean age (F) = {baseline_balance.loc['F', 'age']:.2f}")
print(f"Mean age (M) = {baseline_balance.loc['M', 'age']:.2f}")
print(f"Age difference (F - M) = {age_diff:.2f}")
print(f"Mean biomarker_baseline (F) = {baseline_balance.loc['F', 'biomarker_baseline']:.2f}")
print(f"Mean biomarker_baseline (M) = {baseline_balance.loc['M', 'biomarker_baseline']:.2f}")
